clips.title: 贝莱德罗森伯格：60/40配置难言回归 通胀环境下债券对冲功能减弱
title_lines: 贝莱德罗森伯格谈配置
通胀环境下债券对冲功能减弱

subtitles.en: So it's a good time to be a saver once again, and if you have a traditional pension plan, it's also good.
subtitles.zh: 所以现在又是储蓄的好时机，如果你有传统养老金计划，那也不错。
en_highlights: good time to be a saver

subtitles.en: But with higher yields, do we now say, okay, the 60-40 portfolio?
subtitles.zh: 但随着收益率上升，我们现在是否可以说，60-40组合又行了？

subtitles.en: Oh, that works again. So you're really spot on to highlight both sides of this, right? The liability side, the mortgages,
subtitles.zh: 哦，又管用了。你确实点出了问题的两面，对吧？负债端，抵押贷款，

subtitles.en: that's a little painful, but the opportunity side on the investment side is better.
subtitles.zh: 那有点痛苦，但**端的机会更好。

subtitles.en: I don't think you can conclude 60-40 is back because there's another whole issue with bonds, which is how do they perform with equities?
subtitles.zh: 我不认为可以断定60-40组合回来了，因为债券还有一个问题，就是它们与权益资产的表现如何？

subtitles.en: What's the relationship? And that relationship used to be very powerfully diversifying.
subtitles.zh: 是什么关系？这种关系曾经非常有效地分散风险。

subtitles.en: We had an environment where bonds would reliably go up whenever there was a challenge to equities.
subtitles.zh: 我们曾处于一个环境，每当权益资产面临挑战时，债券都会可靠地上涨。

subtitles.en: That was an environment when we had two little inflation. So that's over, we're five years into too much inflation.
subtitles.zh: 那是一个通胀很低的环境。所以那已经结束了，我们进入通胀过高的阶段已经五年了。

subtitles.en: When you have too much inflation, bonds aren't really a hedge anymore. They're good for income, as you pointed out, and that's the way to think about them.
subtitles.zh: 当通胀过高时，债券不再是对冲工具。它们适合提供收入，正如你指出的，这就是思考它们的方式。

subtitles.en: But for diversification, we're gonna have to think about broadening our diversifier set away from just thinking about the traditional 60-40.
subtitles.zh: 但为了分散风险，我们必须考虑拓宽分散化工具集，而不仅仅是传统的60-40。

subtitles.en: We talk about it 50-30-20. And so what's that 20?
It's alternatives and different forms of diversification to add into the portfolio mix.
subtitles.zh: 是另类资产和不同形式的分散配置，加入组合中。
